decisions.quote:
Analyst success criteria: All outcomes meet the Precise Reproduction Criteria
Reproduction outcome: Based on these criteria, the claim did not reproduce.
Discussion: Reproduction of the single trace claim was unsuccessful possibly owing to the aforementioned discrepancies identified in data processing in Ku & Zaroff (2014). Moreover, the df value for the claim in the original paper is reported as 79 – arising queries about the sample size used in the analysis (which is reported as 155 in the original paper).
decisions.location: Claim evaluations, Claim ID: single-trace, lines 75-77
decisions.reason: The full-text SCORE 'Author Data Reproduction Attempt' report only evaluates computational reproducibility against 'Precise Reproduction Criteria' for both tested claims ('All outcomes meet the Precise Reproduction Criteria'). Although the analyst revised item inclusion and reverse-scoring rules when constructing the processed dataset 'for the purpose of the reproduction', the report runs a single reproduction analysis per claim to check whether the original reported numbers are recovered and does not conduct robustness checks or evaluate whether the substantive findings survive alternative specifications.
